entries.title: Linked Project Backup
entries.body: Linked projects show a header icon that restores the one-time backup of the original TTML after confirming (the backup is removed once restored), and the Linked tab can open the folder that holds it. The header also shows an unsaved changes button that saves the project.

entries.title: Sync Timing
entries.body: Synced times no longer drift when the audio stalls, buffers or changes speed, and the delay between pressing a sync key and the app handling it is removed at every playback speed. Syncing into the next line no longer leaves its first word with an old end time.

entries.title: Linked Projects
entries.body: When the app offers to create a project, choose Keep files in place to leave your TTML and audio where they are. The project only stores their locations, and reopening works from Projects. Nothing is written on linking or autosave: only an explicit save writes the TTML back to the original file, after keeping a one-time backup of the original in the project's data folder.

entries.title: Projects Window
entries.body: Added a Linked tab with an Open projects folder button, a search field for Recent, Linked, and Workspace projects, and labels that show whether a project is a folder or linked files.

entries.title: Settings Search
entries.body: Preferences has a search field. Typing a setting name filters the categories, opens the best match, and highlights the closest setting.

entries.title: Backup Contents Preview
entries.body: Added an expandable preview dropdown before exporting settings and data backups, displaying category counts, item lists, and estimated total file size.

entries.title: Backup Assets
entries.body: Appearance presets and the custom font are now exported and restored with the Assets category.

entries.title: Preferences UI Polish & Icons
entries.body: Clarified preset actions with dedicated apply/delete icons and tooltips, harmonized semantic icons across General, Editor, Files, Audio, Keybindings, Appearance, Developer, and Custom Background tabs, and improved contrast for advanced configuration resets.

entries.title: Spectrogram Divider Styling
entries.body: Decluttered touching dividers when adjacent lyric lines meet by shortening handle indicators and removing corner notches for seamless line boundaries.

entries.title: Backup Safety
entries.body: API keys (Genius and AI Sidebar) now have their own opt-in "API keys" category, off by default, and are never included with Settings. The last workspace folder and recent project paths are not exported because they only make sense on the original device.

entries.title: Timing Overview Header
entries.body: Kept the timing overview header compact and readable when resizing to narrow side panels, and remember whether the side preview is open between sessions.

entries.title: Domain Move Complete
entries.body: The old tool addresses now redirect to tool.community.spicylyrics.org, so the one-time data transfer from them has been removed.

entries.title: Backup Tab Translation
entries.body: The Backup settings tab is now fully translated to Spanish.

entries.title: Duplicate Desktop Installs
entries.body: v0.10.0 and v0.10.1 were installed as "NaeNae AMLL TTML Tool Fork" next to the existing "AMLL TTML Tool" instead of replacing it. The installed app is named "AMLL TTML Tool" again, and the Windows installers, .deb, and .rpm packages now remove the extra copy. Your settings and projects are kept, and Winget recognizes the app again.

entries.title: macOS Downloads
entries.body: Releases now ship separate Apple Silicon (aarch64) and Intel (x64) DMGs only. The universal DMG is no longer built, which makes releases noticeably faster to publish.

entries.title: App Icon Shape
entries.body: The purple app icon is a rounded tile with transparent padding again instead of a sharp full-bleed square, so it matches other apps on the taskbar, dock, and in browser tabs.

entries.title: Folder Projects (Opt-In)
entries.body: Open, save, and organize lyrics as project folders from the File menu (Projects), with a project.json manifest, recent projects, and workspace scanning. Enable it under Files & Storage settings; it stays off by default and the app behaves exactly as before while disabled.

entries.title: Create Project Prompt
entries.body: Loading a lyric file together with audio now offers to create a project. Choosing Create asks for a location and builds a folder named after the song, or Untitled Song-1, Untitled Song-2, and so on when no name is available.

entries.title: Automatic Folder Naming
entries.body: The project folder follows the song metadata when you save. Folders you rename yourself are never touched, and existing folders are never renamed unless the app created them.

entries.title: Project-Wide Saving
entries.body: Ctrl+S inside a project saves the project instead of exporting standalone TTML, without prompting when nothing changed, and unsaved changes still trigger a warning before opening another file or project.

entries.title: Resilient Project Manifest
entries.body: project.json now carries a project identifier and a song fingerprint, so the lyric and audio files are found again after being renamed outside the app. Older manifests keep working.

entries.title: Safe File Access
entries.body: All project paths are validated against traversal and reserved names, file sizes are capped, and folder access is granted only through folders you pick in the native dialog.

entries.title: Saved-State Tracking
entries.body: Saving now clears the unsaved-changes warning while keeping your undo history, edits made during a save stay marked as unsaved, and undoing back to the saved version reads as saved again.

entries.title: Lyric File Import
entries.body: Fixed file dialog triggers for LRC, ESLRC, QRC, YRC, and Lyricify Syllable formats so clicking import options in the File menu immediately opens the file picker.

entries.title: Link Embeds
entries.body: Added short link embeds for Discord, Google, social sharing, and search previews.

entries.title: New App Logo & Naming
entries.body: Replaced the red icon across the website, PWA, desktop, and mobile assets with the new multicolor logo, using platform-specific padding and masks. The app now consistently uses NaeNae's AMLL TTML Tool Fork, with the full Apple Music-like Lyrics name where space permits.

entries.title: Themed Glassmorphic Toast Notifications
entries.body: Toast notifications now feature glassmorphic translucent styling with background blur, follow the app's global radius, and synchronize icon and progress bar colors with the active theme accent.

entries.title: Updated Beginner Guide Links
entries.body: In-app onboarding and Genius token help now open the current Spicy Lyrics guides instead of the retired documentation site.

entries.title: Timing Overview Syllable Seeking
entries.body: Clicking any syllable or word in the Technical Timing Overview now seeks directly to that word's timestamp and displays its active frame, while table auto-scroll smoothly follows playback without getting stuck.

entries.title: Cross-Tab Position Sync
entries.body: Switching between Edit, Time, and Preview tabs maintains playback position and keeps the active line centered, with anchor restoration scoped to tab mounting to prevent view jitter during word and line synchronization.

entries.title: Wrapped Line Borders & Highlight Persistence
entries.body: Wrapped lyric rows without timestamps now display their left border indicator, active syllable highlights remain synchronized across selection and pause states, and auto-scroll easing uses a smooth sine curve with proportional duration.

entries.title: Timing Overview Order Mode
entries.body: Added a toggle in the Technical Timing Overview between chronological order and natural textual document order, keeping unsynchronized lines in their original lyrical sequence.

entries.title: Test Runner & Spectrogram Optimization
entries.body: Configured standard test runner scripts for Vitest and full-suite runs, eliminated redundant spectrogram tile re-renders during resizing, and removed unused dependencies across spectrogram components.

entries.title: Word Wrap in Time Mode
entries.body: Lyric word cards in the Time tab now wrap onto multiple lines instead of overflowing horizontally. Toggle "Wrap Words in Time Mode" from the Display Options ribbon or the Editor & Sync settings. Wrapping is on by default and animates smoothly with a fade-in reflow.

entries.title: Playback Auto-Scroll
entries.body: While playing back in the Time tab the editor automatically scrolls to keep the active lyric line centered. Auto-scroll can be toggled from Editor & Sync settings and defaults to on.

entries.title: Main Vocal Focus Priority
entries.body: When auto-scroll is active the editor focuses on the main (v1) vocal line and disregards background vocals unless no main vocal is ongoing. This can be toggled via "Focus Main Line During Playback", which greys out when auto-scroll is disabled.

entries.title: User-Scroll Pause & Resume
entries.body: Scrolling with the mouse wheel suspends auto-scroll for one second before smoothly resuming to the active line. Auto-scroll and resume timers remain inactive while playback is paused.

entries.title: Sync to Spectrogram Cursor
entries.body: Added an opt-in setting to record timing trigger keys (F, G, H) at the spectrogram hover cursor position instead of the current audio playback time.

entries.title: Dynamic Spectrogram Height & Dividers
entries.body: The spectrogram height slider now dynamically measures titlebar and playback controls to prevent pushing UI controls offscreen. Word divider dragging no longer imposes artificial zoom-dependent minimum duration limits, and FFT resolution uses a clean inline selector.

entries.title: Focused Default Dark Theme
entries.body: Reworked the modern dark theme with clearer charcoal layers, quieter labels, tighter lyric cards, and crimson reserved for active states and primary actions. The legacy theme remains unchanged.

entries.title: Adjustable Interface Scale
entries.body: Resize the whole app from Appearance settings or with Ctrl/Cmd +, -, and 0 shortcuts, with the chosen scale remembered across sessions.

entries.title: Remembered Background Vocal Export
entries.body: Fixed exports sometimes ignoring the saved consecutive and standalone background-vocal setting until it was toggled again.

entries.title: Stable Mode Switching
entries.body: Switching between Edit and Time mode now keeps the same lyric line in view without centering lines selected while editing.

entries.title: Clearer Beginner Guide
entries.body: Added a preparation step that pairs the in-app walkthrough with the full TTML guide, provides compact lyric-source cards, and fixes guide navigation and documentation links.

entries.title: Flexible Background Vocal Export
entries.body: Added an optional Spicy Lyrics-compatible export mode for consecutive and standalone background-vocal lines, with reliable re-importing and empty editor lines ignored during export.

entries.title: Remembered Lyric Import Options
entries.body: Process Lyrics and Genius songwriter and header options now persist across import sources and app sessions.

entries.title: Discord Album Artwork
entries.body: Show a project's web cover image in native Discord presence, with safe fallback to the app logo when no usable cover URL is available.

entries.title: Reliable Word Auditioning
entries.body: Play exact word slices from the spectrogram on Linux and web without duplicate right-click playback or incorrect desktop volume scaling.

entries.title: Organized Settings
entries.body: Replaced the crowded tab strip with sidebar navigation, grouped editor, file, audio, and appearance controls by purpose, consolidated AI setup, and collapsed advanced configuration until it is needed.

entries.title: Customizable Discord Presence
entries.body: Build native Discord status lines from project, editor, playback, and session variables; control timers, badges, and the repository button; and automatically hide project details after a configurable period of inactivity.

entries.title: Quick Combine Words
entries.body: Shift-click Combine Words to skip the confirmation dialog and immediately use the last-used combination options.

entries.title: Discord Status Badge
entries.body: Play and pause badges now use valid image assets so the selected status icon appears in Discord.

entries.title: Reliable Rapid Undo
entries.body: Undo and redo now wait for the editor to paint between full-project history updates, preventing repeated shortcuts from freezing the app window.

entries.title: Native Arch Linux Package
entries.body: Added a PKGBUILD and desktop entry for native installation on Arch Linux and Arch-based distributions, avoiding AppImage system-library compatibility problems.

entries.title: Optional Time Mode Double-Click Editing
entries.body: Added an Assistant setting to disable inline word and romanization editing on double-click while keeping the Split Word shortcut.

entries.title: Reliable Native Builds
entries.body: Arch packages now use locked dependencies, preserve distribution build flags, declare the AppIndicator dependency, and fail when compilation fails.

entries.title: Modern Linux AppImage Audio
entries.body: AppImages now use the host's matching GStreamer runtime and plugins, restoring audio loading on current Arch Linux and CachyOS systems.

entries.title: Official Domain Migration
entries.body: Old web domains now offer a private browser-to-browser transfer for settings, projects, history, backgrounds, keybindings, and plugins before moving to tool.community.spicylyrics.org.

entries.title: Classic Dark Theme
entries.body: Added an Advanced Customization toggle for restoring the lighter dark palette used before the Intonated Black redesign.

entries.title: Reliable Linux Startup
entries.body: Fixed the desktop app remaining hidden at launch when WebKitGTK pauses animation frames for hidden windows.

entries.title: Single Linux Title Bar
entries.body: Disabled the native window decoration so Linux shows only the app's custom title bar.

entries.title: Intonated Black Theme
entries.body: Revamped the default dark theme with a premium, deep-black aesthetic, eliminating washed-out gray hues and introducing elegant translucent panel overlays.

entries.title: Master Theme Reset
entries.body: Added a single-click button in the basic appearance settings to completely reset all colors, backgrounds, custom gradients, and advanced granular overrides back to their defaults.

entries.title: Onboarding Enhancements
entries.body: Added a "Before you start" tip box to step one of the beginner guide, direct links to appearance settings, a sleek hover-based edge restore button, and smooth fade transitions when tucking the guide.

entries.title: Native Desktop File Dialogs
entries.body: Desktop builds now use native system pickers for lyrics and audio while the web app keeps its browser file picker.

entries.title: Import Source Chooser
entries.body: The empty editor now offers clear Plain Text, LRCLIB, Lyrically, and Genius cards so you can choose an import source before opening its workflow.

entries.title: Linux Audio Playback
entries.body: Desktop audio now loads reliably through Tauri's selected-file protocol on Linux, without breaking playback volume or seeking.

entries.title: Reliable Word Double-Clicks
entries.body: Selecting a word in Edit mode no longer recenters the lyric line or word before the second click lands. The horizontal ribbon also keeps a stable height as selection-specific controls appear, while Time mode tracking and explicit navigation retain their existing centering behavior.

entries.title: Fixed First-Run Welcome
entries.body: The beginner welcome now appears automatically only once instead of reopening on every app startup. It remains available from the Help menu.

entries.title: Interactive Beginner Guide
entries.body: A first-run, in-app workflow now teaches audio import, lyric review, timing, credits, export, and local testing using your own song with focused, state-aware steps. The guide window can be moved or tucked into a compact edge tab. Contextual ribbon controls keep advanced options out of the way until needed.

entries.title: Edge-to-Edge Audio Bar
entries.body: The playback controls now span the full workspace width without an outer inset.

entries.title: Edge-to-Edge Lyric Lines
entries.body: Lyric line cards now extend to both sides of the editor without outer margins.

entries.title: Connected Word Groups
entries.body: Split words and other adjacent words without a space now join edge-to-edge, with rounded corners only at the outside of each group. Per-word romanization follows the same grouping and appearance controls.

entries.title: Compact Space Chips
entries.body: Blank words in Edit mode now use empty chips whose width reflects the number of spaces, while keeping the count on hover and offering a legacy Space xN display option in Appearance settings.

entries.title: Combine Words Bulk Controls
entries.body: Preview a word combination before confirming it, apply the same combination to matching sequences throughout the lyrics, and optionally ignore case and surrounding punctuation.

entries.title: Replace Romanization
entries.body: Edit one word's romanization or apply the replacement to every matching lyric word with optional case-sensitive matching. Both replacement tools remember their last-used matching options.

entries.title: Header-Free Timing Tools
entries.body: Copy selected line and word timings onto existing lyric lines, or snap any selected timing block to the playhead in Edit and Time modes without Genius headers.

entries.title: Remembered Desktop Window
entries.body: Desktop builds now restore the previous window size, maximized state, and fullscreen state when reopened.

entries.title: Polish Syllabification
entries.body: Polish lyrics can now use dedicated hyphenation patterns and automatically suggest the matching segmentation engine.

entries.title: Persistent Discord Project Time
entries.body: Discord Rich Presence now remembers time spent on each project across line changes, pauses, project switches, and app restarts.

entries.title: Global Text Normalization
entries.body: The apostrophe and Cyrillic E options now clean all user-visible fields during import and every export, including metadata, sections, marks, ruby text, and legacy headers, while preserving internal identifiers.

entries.title: Romanization Performance & Accuracy
entries.body: Conversion uses bounded remote requests and retryable fallbacks, maps contextual Mandarin readings to individual Han characters, and preserves source spacing in mixed-language line romanization.

entries.title: Editor Input Polish
entries.body: Word and romanization inputs now size and center their contents more naturally, with improved lyric-line editing hit areas.

entries.title: Consistent Release Versioning
entries.body: Maintainers can preview and apply patch, minor, or major version bumps with one command, keeping the package, Tauri, Cargo, and lockfile versions synchronized.

entries.title: Line Insert Button Fix
entries.body: The add button at the right of a lyric line now works correctly while line dragging is enabled.

entries.title: Word-Timed TTML Export Fix
entries.body: Lines containing multiple timed words no longer export as a single line when they retain a stale line-synced flag.

entries.title: Discord Rich Presence
entries.body: Desktop users can optionally share the current file or track, editor mode, line progress, play/pause status, and a speed-aware playback timeline, with a link to this repository.

entries.title: Reliable PreMiD Presence
entries.body: The website now exposes live editor and playback state through a stable bridge. The base editor keeps a compatibility fallback and each version links to its correct repository.

entries.title: Inline Time-Tab Editing
entries.body: Double-click a synced word to edit it directly; when per-word romanization is displayed, it edits the romanization instead.

entries.title: Split Word Shortcut
entries.body: Ctrl/Cmd-double-clicking a word in either Edit or Time mode now opens the standard Split Word dialog for that word instead of using the legacy line-level shortcut.

entries.title: TTML Checklist
entries.body: Keep a persistent local queue of songs to sync, with notes and a completed history.

entries.title: Website Update Recovery
entries.body: Website users can now force a refresh or clear cached website files when an update prompt fails to appear.

entries.title: Translation Updates
entries.body: Refreshed translations for 16 supported locales.

entries.title: Edit-Tab Romanization Cleanup
entries.body: Removed the redundant gray romanization text under words now that each word has its own editor.

entries.title: Quick Fixes Cleanup
entries.body: Removed the unused grammar Quick Fixes controls from sync and assistant settings.

entries.title: Line Reordering Fix
entries.body: Dragging lyric lines now scrolls the editor reliably at its edges and supports mouse-wheel and trackpad scrolling while held.

entries.title: Linux AppImage Fix
entries.body: AppImages now use the host Wayland libraries and show their window reliably, preventing startup failures on newer Linux graphics stacks.

entries.title: External Links & Build Info Fix
entries.body: About and changelog links now open correctly in the desktop app, and hosted builds show their Git commit instead of “unknown.”

entries.title: Optional AI Fun Sidebar
entries.body: Enable a manual, bring-your-own-provider TTML vibe check with personalities ranging from Glazer to Unhinged. It stays off by default and never changes your lyrics.

entries.title: Cyrillic E Import Preference
entries.body: Added an optional workaround that corrects Cyrillic Е/е lookalikes inside otherwise Latin text across imported lyric fields.

entries.title: Apostrophe Import Preference
entries.body: Added a setting to standardize curly and other apostrophe-like characters when importing lyric text, metadata, sections, and marks.

entries.title: Genius Import Fix
entries.body: Restored the Change API Key button in the Genius lyric-import dialog.

entries.title: Playback Timeline Fix
entries.body: The waveform playhead now recovers from audio stalls and long frame gaps without sacrificing smooth playback at slower speeds.

entries.title: Genius Section Improvements
entries.body: Duplicated lyric lines now create independent repeat-linked sections; collapsed headers select their whole section; unassigned lyric blocks can be merged into neighboring sections; repeated-section timing copy matches lyric text and skips mismatches; and a section manager makes reviewing and editing sections easier.

entries.title: Auto Segment Shortcut
entries.body: Press the configured Auto Segment key once or twice, with a Keybindings option to choose the preferred behavior. It applies immediately when the saved engine matches the detected lyric language, otherwise it opens the engine picker.

entries.title: Spicy Lyrics Option
entries.body: Added a preview toggle to force every lyric line to use line rendering due to unreliable line-synced lyrics detection.

entries.title: Localization
entries.body: Added missing translation keys and localized section, timing, and auto-segmentation controls.

entries.title: Prosodic Segmentation Fix
entries.body: English contractions using typographic apostrophes, such as “we’re” and “they’re”, now stay together.

entries.title: Desktop Update Fix
entries.body: Desktop builds now check immutable published releases for updates, so future updates download from permanent versioned installers.

entries.title: Spicy Lyrics Fix
entries.body: The Spicy Lyrics preview now preserves TTML line order when line timestamps are out of sequence.

entries.title: Spicy Lyrics Fix
entries.body: Interlude dots now ignore background-vocal endings while waiting for all main vocals to finish.

entries.title: Selectable Syllabification Engines
entries.body: Auto Segment and Advanced Segmentation now offer dedicated English, Spanish, French, Russian, Japanese, and CJK engines alongside clearly labelled legacy fallbacks. The Auto Segment dialog suggests an engine from the lyric language.

entries.title: Learned Word Splits
entries.body: Manual split boundaries can now be remembered and automatically reused for future occurrences of the same word.

entries.title: Persistent Split Dialog Options
entries.body: The Split Word dialog now remembers its last-used options, reducing repeated setup when correcting multiple words.

entries.title: Lyric Preparation Fix
entries.body: CJK text now splits correctly around non-Latin commas even when there is no surrounding space.

entries.title: Scoped Time Stretch
entries.body: Time Stretch can now be applied to all lines, selected lines, selected lines and everything following them, or a custom line range.

entries.title: Genius Section Workflow
entries.body: Added normalized section categories, required import review, repeat detection, a collapsible section navigator, rich section metadata and actions, live validation, and lossless TTML section metadata.

entries.title: Spicy Lyrics Preview Mode
entries.body: Added a high-fidelity Spicy Lyrics renderer with its dedicated SF Pro-derived font; animated, custom, and cover-art backgrounds; karaoke, Simple Lyrics, and line-synced rendering; interlude dots; RTL- and duet-aware layouts; CJK/romanized word wrapping; automatic scrolling; and an optional FPS counter.

entries.title: Timing Stretch
entries.body: Added a TTML timing-stretch tool that can import audio duration and scale lyric timing to match it.

entries.title: Unified Lyrics Import
entries.body: Consolidated text, LRCLIB, Lyrically, and Genius imports into one workflow with shared lyric preparation, replacement confirmation, and consistent punctuation, CJK/Latin boundary, word-separator, and background-vocal handling.

entries.title: Genius Header Categorization & Section Tools
entries.body: Preserve bracketed Genius headers such as `[Chorus]` and `[Verse]` as section metadata instead of lyric lines. Sections are visually grouped and color-coded by type, with a customizable header-color override; unrecognized headers use the theme accent. Sync actions can snap an entire section to the playhead or copy timing from a previous matching section.

entries.title: Backup System
entries.body: Added a new backup system to help protect project data and simplify recovery.

entries.title: Tauri CI
entries.body: Repaired the GitHub Actions build key configuration.

entries.title: Preview Layout Fixes
entries.body: Fixed the Time-mode preview pane being pushed off-screen after its contents loaded, and hide the side preview pane when the full Preview screen is active.

entries.title: Genius Import Fixes
entries.body: Switched Genius fetching to its CORS-enabled embed endpoint and cleaned up parsed newlines and import-dialog crashes.

entries.title: Bouncy Indicator
entries.body: Words in the Sync view that qualify as long-duration syllables now display a small animated bouncing dot beneath them. A word qualifies when its letter count is 12 or fewer *and* its duration meets the threshold `1000 + (letterLength - 1) × 25` ms — helping you instantly spot held or sustained syllables that may need extra timing attention.

entries.title: Zero Performance Cost
entries.body: The indicator is driven purely by CSS keyframe animation with no runtime subscriptions or re-renders. It appears only in Sync mode and is invisible during playback active state, keeping the editing surface clean.

entries.title: Preview Panel Stability
entries.body: Fixed a critical "white page" crash when toggling the Preview Panel in Sync mode by resolving a missing component import in the main application layout.

entries.title: Toxi Animation Correction
entries.body: Fixed a bug where the "jump-down" word animation was incorrectly disabled when "Instant Fade Out" was active. High-fidelity Toxi animations now work consistently with all highlight settings.

entries.title: Instant Highlight Fade
entries.body: Added a new toggle in both Preview and Sync modes to switch between smooth fading and instant transitions for word highlights. Perfect for high-precision timing review.

entries.title: Scrapped Element Resizing
entries.body: Officially scrapped the experimental "Element Resizing" mode and associated keybindings (Ctrl+Alt). This eliminates potential layout conflicts and simplifies the core interface.

entries.title: Enhanced "What's New"
entries.body: Expanded the feature guide to include 12 core tool features with dedicated "Info" buttons for direct usage guidance and localized documentation.

entries.title: Millisecond Sync Precision
entries.body: Implemented high-precision audio time interpolation and eliminated rounding jitter in the sync engine. Timing errors of 1-3ms are now fully resolved.

entries.title: Export Validation
entries.body: Added an automated sync health check when exporting. The tool now detects untimed lyrics and offers to jump directly to errors for correction.

entries.title: Genius Tag Filtering
entries.body: The "Process Lyrics" tool now automatically strips section headers (e.g., [Chorus]) and removes empty lines for a cleaner import.

entries.title: Standardized Defaults
entries.body: Updated the default preview mode to "Standard" for better initial clarity on new projects.

entries.title: Improved Dialogs
entries.body: Enhanced the confirmation dialog system with support for custom action labels and better navigation between error states.

entries.title: GPU Bottleneck Elimination
entries.body: Removed expensive `backdrop-filter: blur` on the full-viewport overlay, resolving severe rendering lag and re-compositing overhead on integrated GPUs.

entries.title: Optimized Mesh Gradients
entries.body: Implemented 0.5x Smart Scaling for the mesh background. This reduces the background GPU workload by ~50% with no visible quality loss on blurred surfaces.

entries.title: Smart Mesh Animation
entries.body: Tied background animation state directly to audio playback. The mesh gradient now freezes when paused to eliminate idle power consumption and GPU usage.

entries.title: High-Efficiency Bloom
entries.body: Switched from `drop-shadow` filters to multi-layered `text-shadow` for active words in Standard mode, significantly improving frame pacing and stability.

entries.title: GPU VRAM Management
entries.body: Removed global `will-change` over-promotion from static words to prevent VRAM exhaustion and layout thrashing on large projects.

entries.title: Scoped Layer Promotion
entries.body: Optimized hardware layer promotion to trigger only on active words, ensuring maximum rendering throughput for the Toxi engine.

entries.title: Project Migration
entries.body: The repository has officially moved to `NaeNaeTart/NaeNae-AMLL-TTML-TOOL`. All documentation, license headers, and internal links have been standardized to reflect this change.

entries.title: Snap to Playhead
entries.body: Added a high-precision synchronization tool in the Time Shift toolbar. Align your lyrics instantly by snapping line start times to your current audio playback position.

entries.title: Circular Snap Button
entries.body: Refined the Snap tool with a dedicated circular "Record" icon for a cleaner, more intuitive synchronization workflow.

entries.title: Context Menu Enhancements
entries.body: Added "Move line to playhead" to the lyric line right-click menu and optimized existing sync actions for better usability.

entries.title: Repository Cleanup
entries.body: Removed legacy lockfiles and workspace definitions to optimize the environment for modern package managers like pnpm.

entries.title: Enhanced Duplicate-to-Selection
entries.body: `CTRL + L` now intelligently uses the spectrogram selection range. Duplicated lines and their words are automatically distributed equally across the selected time range for instant, high-precision timing application.

entries.title: Interactive UI Rain Effect
entries.body: Clicking the mascot in the title bar triggers a high-performance "rain" animation. Built with optimized React memoization to ensure zero impact on the core editing performance.

entries.title: Rendering Stack Optimization
entries.body: Refactored global layout components to isolate dynamic visual effects, preventing unnecessary re-renders of the main application during animations.

entries.title: Mascot Asset Restoration
entries.body: Updated the title bar mascot with a working high-reliability remote GIF asset, resolving the broken image issue.

entries.title: Community Plugin Store
entries.body: Introduced a new, cloud-synced plugin architecture. Browse and install community-made WASM plugins directly from the integrated store.

entries.title: Security Verification Engine
entries.body: Implemented SHA-256 integrity checks for all community plugins. The tool now automatically verifies every download to protect your environment from tampering.

entries.title: Flexible Plugin Registry
entries.body: Switched to a GitHub-backed remote registry system, allowing for instant, zero-cost updates and community contributions via Pull Requests.

entries.title: Improved Hash Handling
entries.body: Standardized plugin verification to be case-insensitive, ensuring reliable installation across different platforms and hash tools (like PowerShell vs Browser).

entries.title: Toxi Lyrics Engine
entries.body: Re-engineered the Toxi lyric style with high-fidelity "jump-down" animations, instant-hit blooming with smooth fade-out, and adjustable wipe softness.

entries.title: 144Hz+ Rendering Loop
entries.body: Implemented a dedicated interpolation engine that bypasses React bottlenecks, enabling true high-refresh-rate rendering on ProMotion and gaming monitors.

entries.title: V-Sync & FPS Counter
entries.body: Introduced performance monitoring tools. Uncap your frame rate with the new V-Sync toggle and track real-time delivery with the FPS counter overlay.

entries.title: Rendering Consistency
entries.body: Unified the rendering path across all word states to eliminate font "thickening" artifacts and sub-pixel shifts, ensuring perfectly sharp lyrics from start to finish.

entries.title: Advanced Appearance Editor
entries.body: Introduced a high-fidelity visual editor with support for 40+ granular visual parameters. Customize everything from background gradients and glassmorphism levels to global border radii and drop shadows.

entries.title: Visual Preset System
entries.body: Added a robust preset management system. Save your favorite visual configurations, load them instantly, and share your unique themes with the community.

entries.title: Audio Pitch Preservation
entries.body: Added a new "Preserve Pitch" toggle in the audio settings. You can now choose whether the audio pitch should change when adjusting the playback speed — perfect for high-speed transcription.

entries.title: Stability & Localization
entries.body: Resolved multiple compilation conflicts and duplicate state declarations. Standardized English labels across new audio controls for better international consistency.

entries.title: Preferences Tab Overflow
entries.body: Enabled horizontal scrolling and fixed-width triggers for the Preferences dialog tabs. This prevents labels from being cut off or compressed in languages with long strings like Russian.

entries.title: Urban Dictionary Syllable Concatenation
entries.body: When fetching from Urban Dictionary, if multiple syllables or words are selected, they are now automatically combined into a single query term. This is especially useful for slang words that are split across multiple timing segments.

entries.title: Header Glassmorphism Overhaul
entries.body: Fixed inconsistent blur effects in the top bar area. The TitleBar and RibbonBar are now unified with a robust glassmorphism effect, featuring improved backdrop-filter settings (`blur(16px) saturate(160%)`) and matching semi-transparent backgrounds (`var(--gray-a5)`).

entries.title: Integrated Header Layout
entries.body: Removed margins from the RibbonBar card and unified its style with the TitleBar to create a single, cohesive blurred header area.

entries.title: Improved Layout Stability
entries.body: Fixed several invalid `0fr` CSS Grid column definitions in the preview and sync mode ribbon bars, ensuring more stable rendering across different window sizes.

entries.title: AMLL Preview Mode
entries.body: Added a dedicated high-fidelity **AMLL** preview mode powered by the local Apple Music-like lyrics rendering engine, featuring a fluid Mesh Gradient background running at 60 FPS. The mode now correctly fills the entire preview window with the background properly rendered.

entries.title: Background Vocal Grouping (Standard Mode)
entries.body: Main and background vocal lines are rendered as a single unified visual block. When a line becomes active, both the main vocal and its BG vocal(s) scale up together — matching official Apple Music behavior. BG vocals appear in italic beneath the main line with word-level highlighting.

entries.title: Promotion-based Rendering Architecture
entries.body: Inactive lyric lines are now rendered as static, near-zero-cost elements with no real-time subscriptions. Only the active line promotes to full dynamic rendering, reducing React reconciliation work by ~95% and eliminating word-transition lag.

entries.title: GPU-First Acceleration
entries.body: Applied `translate3d`, `backface-visibility: hidden`, `content-visibility: auto`, and `will-change` hints across all lyric lines to maximize GPU compositing, minimize CPU usage, and enable DOM culling for off-screen lines.

entries.title: Removed "Rendered" Mode
entries.body: Consolidated the legacy Rendered AMLL preview into the new AMLL mode. The preview selector now cleanly presents: **Standard**, **AMLL**, and **Timing**.

entries.title: Bug Fixes
entries.body: Fixed a Jotai "Atom is undefined" crash, fixed the AMLL background appearing solid black due to a z-index layering conflict, and fixed lyric auto-scroll snapping to the top on every line change.

entries.title: Community WASM Plugin System
entries.body: A revolutionary extension framework allowing developers to write high-performance importers and exporters in C++ or Rust. Features persistent IndexedDB storage and a dedicated management console located in the brand new **Dev** preferences tab.

entries.title: Advanced Romanization Engine
entries.body: Completely rebuilt the phonetic system for professional-grade synchronization. Supports automated Romaji (JA), Pinyin (ZH), and Romaji (KO) generation with project-level language priority and **capsule-aware distribution** for perfect Japanese mora syncing.

entries.title: Developer Preferences Tab
entries.body: Introduced a dedicated "Dev" category in the Preferences dialog to house advanced technical features, plugin management, and system debug information. Access it to manage your community extensions or check build environments.

entries.title: Integrated MP3-to-FLAC Converter
entries.body: Added a high-fidelity audio processing bridge powered by **FFmpeg.wasm**. The tool now automatically detects MP3 files and offers a streamlined conversion to FLAC format to ensure 100% timing accuracy and eliminate browser-level audio decoding drift during synchronization.

entries.title: Type-Safe Plugin Architecture
entries.body: Refactored the internal core to be fully type-safe, preventing runtime crashes and improving the developer experience for community contributors.

entries.title: UI Performance & Stability
entries.body: Resolved critical Ribbon Bar layout issues, implemented invisible scrollbar utilities for horizontal navigation, and fixed dynamic import failures to ensure a 100% stable and fluid editing experience.

entries.title: Automated Lyrics Prep Engine
entries.body: Completely replaced the external `Lyrprep` dependency with a built-in, local processing engine. The new **"Process Lyrics"** button handles background vocal splitting, space escaping (`\ `), and hyphen splitting (`sh-\sh-`) on the spot without leaving the app.

entries.title: Syllable-Level Alignment
entries.body: Refined the processing logic to match professional synchronization standards. It automatically converts plain text into a syllable-sync-ready format with escaped spaces and hyphens, saving hours of manual formatting.

entries.title: Feature Retirement
entries.body: Removed the experimental AI Auto-Sync tool in favor of more predictable and stable local lyrics processing workflows.

entries.title: Compact Sync Layout
entries.body: Added a new "Compact Background Vocals" feature for the Time tab. This reduces vertical space for background vocals during synchronization, making it easier to manage dense projects. This behavior is toggleable in the Display settings.

entries.title: Smart Space Handling
entries.body: Refined synchronization logic to automatically skip over whitespace-only words. Navigation shortcuts like **H** (Set End Time) and **D** (Next Word) now always land on syllables with actual content.

entries.title: Clean Imports
entries.body: Standardized lyric cleaning during import to automatically strip backslashes (`\`) across all major sources (Genius, Lyrically, Text, LRC) for higher project stability and quality.

entries.title: UI Refinements
entries.body: Improved word separation in Plain Text imports to cleanly remove delimiters without polluting the project with empty words or markers.

entries.title: Custom Audio Equalizer
entries.body: Introduced a professional 10-band equalizer with support for custom presets. Save, name, and manage your own audio profiles for a tailored listening experience.

entries.title: Enhanced EQ Presets
entries.body: Added a curated list of built-in presets including Bass Boost, Treble Boost, Vocal Boost, Rock, Jazz, Pop, and more.

entries.title: Persistence
entries.body: Equalizer settings and custom presets are now automatically saved and persisted across application sessions.

entries.title: UI Stability Fixes
entries.body: Resolved critical layout issues where "space-between" align properties were incorrectly applied, ensuring smoother rendering of settings panels.

entries.title: Type Safety Improvements
entries.body: Optimized component prop typing to prevent runtime UI errors and layout shifts.

entries.title: Duplicate-to-Spot
entries.body: Introduced a "Duplicate to..." workflow. Click indicators between any two lines to instantly place copies of your selection at that exact position.

entries.title: Global Placement Mode
entries.body: Activating "Duplicate to" reveals insertion spacers globally across the editor, providing a one-click visual map for project restructuring.

entries.title: Continuous Duplication (Shift)
entries.body: Holding **Shift** while clicking insertion points keeps the placement mode active, allowing for high-speed batch line replication.

entries.title: Redo Shortcut
entries.body: Updated the Redo shortcut to **Shift + Ctrl + Z** across all platforms for a more intuitive editing workflow.

entries.title: Redo Memory
entries.body: Optimized state management by limiting the Redo/Undo history to the 10 most recent actions for better performance.

entries.title: Static Highlighting
entries.body: Disabled word move animations and glow effects during playback for a more focused and distraction-free synchronization experience.

entries.title: Assistant Tab
entries.body: Introduced a dedicated "Assistant" tab in Settings to manage helper features like Quick Fixes and timing visualization in one place.

entries.title: Flexible Syncing
entries.body: Added a toggle to enable or disable manual timestamp typing in Sync mode, allowing you to lock timings to prevent accidental changes.

entries.title: Smart Selection Persistence
entries.body: Right-clicking no longer clears multi-word selections. This enables powerful bulk operations like "Combine Words" for complex phonetic merging.

entries.title: Clean UI Logic
entries.body: Rebuilt the insertion spacer rendering to resolve stacking bugs and collision issues, ensuring a clutter-free interface with perfectly centered placement points.

entries.title: Refined Plain Text Import
entries.body: Disabled automatic space padding by default to prevent unwanted spacing in imported projects.

entries.title: Lyrically Engine Integration
entries.body: Added a high-reliability alternative lyrics source via the **Lyrically API** (powered by lyrics.ovh). This fallback completely bypasses CORS restrictions and Genius anti-bot measures using server-side aggregation.

entries.title: Bulletproof Scraper Engine
entries.body: Rebuilt the Genius scraper with a **Multi-Proxy Rotation** system and deep `__PRELOADED_STATE__` JSON extraction, ensuring imports work even when the site's layout changes or blocks standard requests.

entries.title: Optimized Import Workflow
entries.body: The import menu now features a dedicated **English Translation** layer with better fallbacks and a cleaner, more responsive preview panel for Lyrically-sourced lyrics.

entries.title: Native CDN Image Loading
entries.body: Switched to direct **Genius CDN** and **HTTPS forced** image links for cover arts. This resolves persistent "403 Forbidden" blocks and "Mixed Content" security errors in browser environments.

entries.title: Multi-Provider Scaling
entries.body: Improved backend logic for handling concurrent requests across different lyric providers.

entries.title: Advanced Font Selection Menu
entries.body: Replaced the basic font list with a high-performance Gallery interface. Features over 300+ of the most popular Google Fonts and system font stacks for total visual control.

entries.title: Custom Typography Support
entries.body: You can now import your own `.ttf`, `.otf`, and `.woff` font files directly. Your custom fonts are securely stored and persist across app sessions.

entries.title: Global Font Variations
entries.body: Integrated full support for **Bold** and *Italic* styles. The tool dynamically fetches the appropriate variants from Google for every library font.

entries.title: Enhanced Font Library UI
entries.body: A refined, searchable interface with live previews, categorized list stacks, and improved spacing to handle long font names without clipping.

entries.title: Rich Preview Panel
entries.body: A new visual preview system for Genius imports that allows you to review, edit, and verify perfectly formatted lyrics before they hit your project.

entries.title: Genius Background Lyric Parser
entries.body: Automatically recognizes parenthesized text as background vocals during import, stripping brackets and setting the appropriate background flag.

entries.title: Ultra-Reliable Genius Cover Arts
entries.body: Implemented a high-performance image proxy service to ensure Genius cover arts load reliably across all platforms, bypassing hotlink protection.

entries.title: Line Sync Mode
entries.body: Easily perform macro-level (line-by-line) syncing. Go to Time > Sync Level and set it to Line instead of Word. Pressing "Start Next Word/Line" automatically fills empty beats with proportionately distributed offsets based on syllables.

entries.title: Syllable Chunk Splitting
entries.body: The Sub-word split menu gives you the option of "Syllable Split" utilizing native hyphenation processing to instantly distribute polysyllabic words properly.

entries.title: Community Guide Repository
entries.body: An interactive catalog is now available on the Import Page with embedded community guides/references for creating perfectly formatted AMLL lyrics.

entries.title: Smart Double Click Editor
entries.body: If Quick Fixes is disabled, double clicking skips context evaluation saving resources and opening the inline-editor quickly.

entries.title: Full Genius Lyrics Import
entries.body: Directly search and import song lyrics from Genius into the editor. Featuring a direct-from-source scraper with **Auto-Slop Removal** to automatically strip section markers ([Chorus], etc.) and metadata blocks.
